text:
leah: heads-up: new SAST ruleset rollout last night caused ~120 failing PRs and then the evidence ingestor started throwing decrypt errors. deploy queue piled up. short thread to coordinate fixes.

marco: saw the spike. repo: sdk/clients + infra/ci. logs show scanner attempted GetCryptoKeyVersion and got PERMISSION_DENIED. link: https://logs.internal/tx/62745-sast -> `rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have permission`

nina: immediate mitigation: disabled the new ruleset and requeued blocked PRs. evidence for some historical runs is still missing because the ingestor couldn't decrypt attachments.

colin: probable cause: a policy change rolled back a legacy IAM grant on the scanner service account as part of a housekeeping sweep. It was unintentional.

leah: two parallel tracks: 1) unblock PRs and restore evidence access, 2) tighten future rollout controls so SAST rule releases can't silently break RBAC.

marco: for unblock: request infra to temporarily grant "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter" to a bounded service token, not permanent SA grant. We'll use the token-broker flow with OTP + 10m TTL.

nina: agree. also we should surface a placeholder evidence artifact if decrypt fails so triage can proceed. placeholder schema: {scan_id, repo, run_ts, error_code, evidence_state: "provisional"}. mark findings provisional in the tracker.

sec-bot: automated: incident created INC-62745-sast-rbac-evidence-loss and assigned to sec-oncall.

colin: longer-term controls: (A) pre-rollout checklist requiring SRE + sec signoff for rules that touch CI artifacts, (B) a pre-sweep dry-run that simulates IAM changes against a canary project, (C) KMS access smoke that runs after any IAM change and before merge.

marco: for audit logging: add `scan_run_id` and `scan_rule_release_tag` to KMS request metadata and to artifact uploads. make sure CloudAudit logs include these labels. That will let us correlate rule rollouts to decrypt errors fast.

leah: sample GH Actions snippet to pass scan id + release tag down to scanner and ingestor:

```yaml
env:
  SCAN_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-sast-${{ github.sha }}
  SAST_RELEASE: "v2026-03-rolling-1"
steps:
  - name: checkout
    uses: actions/checkout@v3
  - name: run sast
    run: ./tools/sast/run_scan.sh --run-id "$SCAN_RUN_ID" --release "$SAST_RELEASE"
  - name: upload artifacts
    run: ./tools/ingest/upload_evidence.sh --run-id "$SCAN_RUN_ID" --release "$SAST_RELEASE"
```

nina: IAM snippet (example):

```json
{
  "members": ["serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"],
  "role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter",
  "condition": {
    "title": "temporary_decrypt_for_backfill",
    "expression": "request.time < timestamp(\"2026-03-23T12:30:00Z\")"
  }
}
```

colin: prefer ephemeral tokens via broker rather than conditional binding. TTL=10m, approval requires 2FA from infra on-call or automated OPA policy that verifies the rollout tag is in the "allowed_releases" list. Log who approved.

marco: add monitoring: if any SAST rule rollout causes >5% of PRs to fail within 30m, auto-disable the release flag and page security + eng leads. call this the "rule blast" detector.

leah: triage changes: when evidence is provisional due to KMS failure, auto-create a high-priority ticket in the vuln tracker with label `provisional-evidence` and assign to scan-owner/team. Once final evidence ingests, ticket should auto-update and lower priority if needed.

ops-bot: automated: created task SEC-TICKET-62745 and queued backfill job.

nina: security notes for the playbook: - never grant permanent decrypt to scanner SA - require audit labels (scan_run_id, requester, release_tag) on all KMS RPCs - escrow allowed only with explicit sec+sre approval, retention 48h, encrypted at rest and ACL'ed to a small group - nightly canary that validates scanner->KMS decrypt flow

colin: add one more: every IAM housekeeping sweep must run a dry-run reporter that lists any SA loses to decryption perms and warn the owners. dry-run must be reviewed if changes affect `scanner@` principals.

leah: action items: - nina: backfill evidence with ephemeral token + write placeholder schema (ETA 4h) - marco: implement rollout kill-switch + rule blast detector (ETA 24h) - colin: RFC for token-broker + OPA approval + dry-run checks (ETA 48h) - leah: update incident playbook with provisional-evidence flow and escrow gating (ETA EOD)

marco: question: who owns the rollout flag gating? tagging @product-eng for policy but for now sec+SRE signoff on any large ruleset.

leah: thanks. will loop product-eng in RFC.

(emoji reactions: :lock: from colin, :white_check_mark: from nina, :eyes: from marco)
